claims.name: shortened_map_target
claims.statement: The repository studies positive non-trivial cycles of T(n)=n/2 for even n and (3n+1)/2 for odd n.
claims.notes: The repository explicitly says the global theorem is not proved.

claims.name: parity_word_full_denominator
claims.statement: A primitive cycle is encoded by a cyclic binary parity word with affine denominator D=2^A-3^L and numerator Q under the recorded hypotheses.
claims.notes: Check primitive and positivity assumptions.

claims.name: full_D_ownership
claims.statement: Genuine integer cycles satisfy the recorded full-denominator divisibility and physical ownership conditions.
claims.status_claimed_by_repository: proved necessary condition at stated hypotheses
claims.notes: Word-level identities do not by themselves distinguish generalized increment.

claims.name: radius3_local_obstruction
claims.statement: The primitive/full-D radius-3 case is closed as a local obstruction under its recorded inherited hypotheses.
claims.notes: No global encounter theorem is included.

claims.name: radius3_bridge_countermodel
claims.statement: The extracted local grammar does not force a radius-3 rotation encounter.
claims.notes: The word is not claimed to be an RL cycle.

claims.name: arbitrary_radius_orbit_identity
claims.statement: The word numerator has an arbitrary-radius orbit-sum representation generalizing sparse radius identities.
hypotheses: binary word and full-D modular setup
claims.notes: The missing nonzero-mod-D theorem remains open.

claims.name: gate_A_architecture
claims.statement: Gate A is a terminal valuation/rank/full-phase route with some closed subcases and an open global remainder.
hypotheses: Gate-A branch selectors and inherited architecture
claims.status_claimed_by_repository: branch/subcase results; Gate A globally open
claims.proof_type: mixed analytic and finite branch results
claims.notes: First-Farey/full-phase cascade is not global without a lift.

claims.name: gate_B_architecture
claims.statement: Gate B is a separate global ownership/encounter obligation for using local obstruction engines.
claims.notes: Closing Gate A alone is not recorded as closing Gate B.

claims.name: generalized_increment_barrier
claims.statement: Homogeneous normalized identities cannot by themselves distinguish ordinary s=1 ownership from generalized increment cycles.
claims.notes: Ordinary +1 physical/integer data must enter non-homogeneously.

claims.name: r1_parent_bridge
claims.statement: R1 is the parent-level bridge stage before R2-R7.
claims.notes: Repository estimate approximately 94% is not a theorem.

claims.name: full_two_row_bridge
claims.statement: RL343 supplies a full physical two-row canonical bridge for the inherited ordered genuine g=2 parent.
hypotheses: ordered genuine g=2, Z0>0, K<0 parent
claims.status_claimed_by_repository: proved analytic bridge at restricted scope
claims.notes: Not all g=2 or all cycles.

claims.name: terminal_escape_certificate
claims.statement: No terminal tail of 60 unit gaps occurs in the stated inherited physical scope.
hypotheses: RL343 parent scope and exact terminal encoding
claims.status_claimed_by_repository: exact finite certificate at stated scope
claims.notes: Finite range and inherited constants require checking.

claims.name: record_profile_reduction
claims.statement: Endpoint-forward records and phase tags characterize complete q=0-to-q=0 returns at the recorded scope.
hypotheses: RL344 q-profile definitions and endpoint trajectory
claims.notes: Does not enumerate or eliminate all returns.

claims.name: terminal_valuation_law
claims.statement: A terminal unit-gap tail is encoded by an exact endpoint valuation law.
hypotheses: genuine last defect and maximal terminal run
claims.notes: Scope is the current parent construction.

claims.name: phases_1_to_3_methodological_closure
claims.statement: Phases 1-3 are closed as methodological reductions while their universal elimination is not claimed.
claims.notes: Terminology crosswalk is essential.

claims.name: singleton_interface
claims.statement: A fixed decorated two-ended interface has at most one physical middle-return lift.
hypotheses: fixed endpoint, length, decorations, and 24-gap prefix
claims.notes: Predecessor/successor and ownership acceptance remain.

claims.name: half_cycle_contact_contraction
claims.statement: RL347 gives decorated rank uniqueness, strict-late geometry, and an L=ell contact-pair separation bound.
claims.notes: Does not eliminate the half-cycle residual.

claims.name: terminal_and_overhalf_laws
claims.statement: RL348 proves a terminal gap/tag law and strict-late complement localization for over-half returns.
claims.notes: Residual CRT/ownership/descent remains.

claims.name: O75_open
claims.statement: The exact owned phase-potential-nondecreasing complete-return obstruction O_75 has not been shown empty.
claims.notes: Three residual classes remain.

claims.name: RL349_orientation_barrier
claims.statement: Live RL349 half-cycle numerical claims require a directed source/end orientation and sign bridge and are not promoted.
claims.notes: Do not revive demoted numerics.

claims.name: RL349_arithmetic_diagnostic
claims.statement: The exact rational inequality ell/(12 log 2) < 32568166831634280/1969739 < n0-1 is certified, but its needed mathematical antecedent is not proved.
hypotheses: log lower enclosure and exact constants
claims.notes: No Phase-4 exclusion follows without the antecedent.

claims.name: R2_to_R7_open
claims.statement: R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7 and the global no-nontrivial-cycle proof remain open.
claims.notes: No end-to-end proof is claimed.
